question: Various Industrialists came together in 1944 and drafted a joint proposal for setting up a planned economy in India. It is famously known as the _____ Plan.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Bombay.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The proposal for setting up a planned economy in India was drafted by various industrialists in 1944, and it was famously known as the Bombay Plan.**
 
• The Bombay Plan aimed to promote industrialization in India and emphasized the role of the private sector in achieving this goal.
 
• The plan proposed a mixed economy model, where the state would provide infrastructure and support to the private sector, and the private sector would drive economic growth.

**First Plan (1951-1956)**

 
• The First Five-Year Plan was **launched in 1951 **which mainly focused on the development of the primary sector.
 
• The First Five-Year Plan was based on the Harrod–Domar model with few modifications.
 
• **This then-president was Jawaharlal Nehru and Gulzarilal Nanda was the vice-president.**
 
• It mainly addressed the agrarian sector, including investment in large dams and irrigation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Five-Year Plans

 
• These are national economic programs that are controlled and integrated.
 
• In 1928, Joseph Stalin implemented the Soviet Union’s first Five-Year Plan.
 
• Most communist countries and a few capitalist ones have since adopted them.
 
• Various Industrialists in 1944 drafted a joint proposal for setting up a planned economy in India **(Bombay Plan).**
 
• Under the socialist influence of Prime Minister Nehru, India established its **First FYP in 1951, shortly after independence.**
